observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission with visible wear, grime, and some blue paint marks. A black cylindrical component with 'BM' written on it is attached to the side.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the same transmission, focusing on the rear section. A label with Chinese characters is visible on the black component, possibly indicating 'Toyota' or a brand name.
Photo 2 shows the front of the transmission, with a star-shaped cover and various bolts and connections. The surface is heavily soiled and dirty.
All photos have a watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the transmission body or components in any photo.
The seller claims to deal in 'Japanese parts and gearbox', but no Japanese brand or model is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Dealer in all kinds of Japanese parts and gearbox
claims.evidence: No Japanese brand or model is visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The transmission may be damaged or non-functional due to visible wear, grime, and lack of visible condition indicators.
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the internal components, fluid condition, and any signs of leaks or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or severely damaged

risks.risk: The transmission may not be from a Toyota or compatible with the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission's identification plate or VIN tag, or a photo showing the transmission installed in a vehicle with visible make/model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown compatibility, possibly incompatible

risks.risk: The transmission may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the transmission's serial number and any damage indicators.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially salvaged, with lower value

proof_requests: Clear photo of the transmission's identification plate or VIN tag.
Close-up video or photo of the internal components and fluid condition.
Photo of the transmission installed in a vehicle, if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
